title: Confidence Interval Calculator
description: Build a 90/95/99% confidence interval for a mean using z (n≥30) or the t-distribution, with all steps.
howto: Enter the sample mean, standard deviation and size.
Press Calculate to see the interval and margin of error.

faqs.q: z or t — which is used?
faqs.a: z for n ≥ 30 (central limit theorem); the t-distribution with df = n−1 for smaller samples, via a built-in t-table.
If you repeated the sampling, about 95% of such intervals would capture the true population mean.

faqs.q: How do I shrink the interval?
faqs.a: Increase n (margin falls as 1/√n) or accept a lower confidence level.
